requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The out-of-box experience (OOBE) for 123.hp.com should present only one consistent product reference name for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series to customers, instead of multiple names.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions on the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must operate correctly without mechanical failure when placed and used on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer should be able to function without failure if tilted left or right by up to 20 degrees while printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must print without print quality issues when placed on a trolley.
